title: Pixazo Adds Ideogram 4.6, Recraft V4.1 Standard, and Stable Diffusion 3.5 APIs to Its Image Generation Catalog
summary: Pixazo adds Ideogram 4.6 Recraft V4.1 and Stable Diffusion 3.5 APIs to its image generation catalog
detailed: "Ideogram 4.6 is the most capable model available for text-accurate image generation at 4K.
Recraft V4.1 Standard adds SVG vector output to the platform -- the first time developers can generate scalable vector assets from a text prompt through Pixazo.
